Who did this?!{wait}{clear}

...Brother. I won't accept an ending like this...{wait}{clear}
Rudi...{wait}{clear}
Why...{n}

Why did this have to happen...{wait}{clear}

It is a terrible loss...{wait}{clear}Rudi... for now...{wait}{clear}
Sorry...{wait}{clear}Could you leave me alone for now...? I'm not in the mood to talk.{wait}{clear}
I don't want to talk right now... Get out.{wait}{clear}
Rudi's Mom

What happened to Hugues... no, to the king, could not be helped, Rudi.{wait}{clear}I am just as grief-stricken as you are.{wait}{clear}But I had always been prepared for something like this to happen.{wait}{clear}
I... can't think of it as something that couldn't be helped. Someone set my brother up, and he died for some reason...{wait}{clear}

You are certainly right about that, Rudi...{wait}{clear}But walking the path of a true king always brings hardship and danger with it.{wait}{clear}The more just the path and the higher the ideals, the more obstacles stand in the way.{wait}{clear}To keep moving forward regardless is what a king... one who leads a nation, must be resolved to from the start.{wait}{clear}The king's death came about on that path. Even if he fell short of his goals, I believe his will lives on...{wait}{clear}
Mom...{wait}{clear}...What do you think I should do now?{wait}{clear}
Rudi... you are a fine young man now.{wait}{clear}Hugues often said so too.{wait}{clear}Keep doing what you believe in. I am sure that will be for the best.{wait}{clear}
What I believe in...{wait}{clear}

Yes... Whether or not you succeed your brother, I don't mind.{wait}{clear}There must be things that only you can do.{wait}{clear}I'm sure Hugues would want you to live your life as yourself.{wait}{clear}
Mom... I...{wait}{clear}
Rudi, if you stay so downhearted forever, Hugues will be sad.{wait}{clear}

My brother... would be sad... Yeah, you're right...{wait}{clear}I listened to so many of my brother's dreams. What he wanted for the country... what it should be...{wait}{clear}I don't know how much I can do, but I want to carry on my brother's will...{wait}{clear}
If you truly cherish your brother in your heart, I'm sure Hugues will be glad.{wait}{clear}I will always be watching over you, Rudi.{wait}{clear}
Thanks, Mom...{wait}{clear}
Sorry... leave me alone a little longer...{wait}{clear}I still haven't sorted out how I feel.{wait}{clear}
Sorry... I'm still not in the mood to talk...{wait}{clear}
Mom... I...{n}{wait}{clear}
No, that's crazy... Is that really true?{wait}{clear}
Noble
Yes. A girl whom someone invited into the palace vanished after the king's death...{wait}{clear}She must surely have been involved in the crime.{wait}{clear}
It can't be...{wait}{clear}
Well, I have no intention of questioning your motives here, Lord Rudiere.{wait}{clear}However, until the culprit is found, we cannot follow you.{wait}{clear}
Wait. I accept that I can't take the throne until I'm cleared of suspicion...{wait}{clear}But the threat from the Empire is real... We have to work together and prepare...{wait}{clear}

I understand, Lord Rudiere. Indeed, the late king often said the same.{wait}{clear}But rather than talk of threats from some distant nation, we have a great deal to do.{wait}{clear}You are still young. Don't be hasty; leave matters to us for now.{wait}{clear}
...Is there no one who agrees with me?{wait}{clear}
...There is not, I'm afraid.{wait}{clear}
.....{wait}{clear}What am I supposed to do...{wait}{clear}
Whether you should take the throne, Lord Rudiere, or we should form a council of nobles, the answer is already clear.{wait}{clear}Do as you please, as you always have.{wait}{clear}
Oh... ＄＄＄＄＄＄...{wait}{clear}
I'm... ashamed of myself, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
My own naivety... it makes me so mad...{wait}{clear}
Those nobles don't care one bit about this country or its people...{wait}{clear}
And I let people like that... steal the country from me...{wait}{clear}
I can't face my brother...{wait}{clear}
What am I supposed to believe in anymore...{wait}{clear}
I...{wait}{clear}
Believe in yourself...{n}
Don't stop now...{n}
For now, believe in yourself...{wait}{clear}I'm sure you will find a light from here on.{wait}{clear}I know you can...{wait}{clear}
Thank you... ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}
I can't afford to stop now, can I...{wait}{clear}
For the sake of the people who believed in me, too...{wait}{clear}
I can only keep going... forward...{wait}{clear}
We cannot stop now.{wait}{clear}The turmoil is spreading. It may be hard, but let's look ahead and keep going...{wait}{clear}
Turmoil is closing in on the world, just like my brother feared...{wait}{clear}
I've got to fight, don't I...{wait}{clear}
Sorry... I made you listen to me whine...{wait}{clear}
What are those monsters...{wait}{clear}
They are not of this world... Most likely demons summoned by the Empire's mages.{wait}{clear}
...Demons.{wait}{clear}Against things like these, ordinary people don't stand a chance.{wait}{clear}
Ngh, here they come again...{wait}{clear}
It's no good... I can't handle this alone... We'd better fall back. ＄＄＄＄＄＄, let's go!{wait}{clear}
...In the end, I couldn't do a thing.{wait}{clear}The kingdom's army is useless as it is now... It's turned out just like my brother feared.{wait}{clear}What should I do...{wait}{clear}
Let's find the real enemy.{n}
Let's think of something.{n}
Let's find the real enemy.{wait}{clear}There must be a root cause behind this turmoil.{wait}{clear}
Yeah, got it...{wait}{clear}Otherwise we'll never stop them, will we?{wait}{clear}
Let's think of something. For the real enemy who is sure to appear someday...{wait}{clear}
I see... I need to get a lot stronger.{wait}{clear}
And for that I have to keep fighting... no, keep surviving.{wait}{clear}

I do{n}

I see... And by the same token, I can't know if it's true that it wasn't her...{wait}{clear}
I understand how you feel, Rudi. If only we knew something more...{wait}{clear}
No, let's drop that for now. Either way, unless we stop the Empire's invasion, peace will never return to this world...{wait}{clear}Right?{wait}{clear}
